predictions: As with most recent seasons, the amount of stuff that goes into the week 1 newsletter prevents me from having enough space to include both the season-long and the weekly picks. But I still do them both, and then report the week 1 results to you guys here, so that we have a full season of picks. And I started off the season at a rate pretty close to what seems to always be about my average. I went 17-8, so I'm sitting at 68% correct so far. Will hopefully raise that a bit as I learn about you teams a bit… == Two 1-0 teams ==

Match of the week: (G Div.) Death Throw @ Nein Mark. My picks for the top two in G both rang up solid week 1 wins, and now they headline the week 2 slate of matches. Quite a possibility that a large piece of the G season race is decided here. I'll stick with my Nein Mark pick, 13-11.

Match #2: (F Div.) One Time @ Heart of Dartness. Dartness, with only one loss in the past year, is off and running again. But the brand new One Time also put forth a strong start and is in the fight for the G lead too. Dartness never makes it easy, but they generally find a way, 14-10.

Match #3: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Dart Attack. Attack took out the first of last season's big three last week, and they are in position to take almost complete control of the A race here in just week 2. I'm afraid, however, that Show Me won't be victim #2. Show Me, 16-8.

Match #4: (D Div.) Area 501 @ Shooter McGavin. I expected a few teams to be key to the D fight, and these two early leaders are both part of that group. As well as McGavin started, this is still Area, 15-9.

Match #5: (E Div.) Ton 80 Proof @ D's Bad News Bears. And poof, just like that, these two showed me I know nothing about E, each trouncing one of my top two E preseason picks last week. Let's see who I can doom this week here… I guess I'll doom Bad News, 13-11.

Match #6: (D Div.) One Armed Bandits @ Menace 2 Sobriety. With D matching up all four 1-0 teams tonight, the winner here is guaranteed to be in the top pairing so far. I think I'll ride with Menace, 13-11. == Two 0-1 Teams ==
Match #7: (E Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Dart Knights. What do I do with two teams I thought were the E heat, but who are now guaranteed to include an 0-2 start? No clue. Knights, barely, 13-11.

Match #8: (D Div.) Breakfast Club @ Nine Lives. The Niners are one of those teams that loves to upset my picks, but if they want to this week, they'll have to lose to do it. Let's go with Niners, 14-10.
Match #9: (A Div.) Jonesing for Mugs @ Wing & a Plaque. Could there even be a chance that Jonesing could start 0-2? Well, there's always a chance, of course, but I just can't see it. Jonesing, 18-6.

Match #10: (D Div.) Rif Raf @ Main Street Mayhem. Rif Raf lost in week 1, but they look like a team that has real potential for a bit of a run. I'm thinking maybe they start a little string tonight, 14-10.

Match #11: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Cheap Shots. The Cheapies let one slip away in 501 last week, and the Shooters only won SCkt of all sets (?!). Somebody is falling in an 0-2 hole. Cheapies, 14-10.
Match #12: (G Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Aim For Fame. Both of these teams need a quick rebound from a slow start. Aim hits, 14-10.
